BaiduSetup.storageFixWhere: These changes are made on the server running Ella, not in this browser. Paths below are examples: substitute your existing video folder and mount point. If someone deployed Ella for you, send them these steps.
BaiduSetup.storageFixDockerFile: Open the deployment folder and edit compose.yml (sometimes named docker-compose.yml). Find the app service and its volumes entry for /videos.
BaiduSetup.storageFixDockerMount: Keep both folder paths unchanged; change only the final mount option:
BaiduSetup.storageFixDockerApply: Save, then run this in the folder containing the Compose file. If you renamed the service, replace app with its name. Recreating the app briefly interrupts access; a simple restart does not apply mount changes.
BaiduSetup.storageFixHost: Direct Linux deployment, or Docker still reports read-only
BaiduSetup.storageFixHostFind: Check the host mount containing the video folder. TARGET is the mount point; ro in OPTIONS means read-only.
BaiduSetup.storageFixHostMount: If the mount was intentionally configured read-only, change ro to rw in its mount settings (usually /etc/fstab). Use the TARGET from the previous command below, not the video subfolder. If remounting fails, ask the storage administrator to check the filesystem rather than forcing it.
BaiduSetup.storageFixNas: For a NAS/SMB share, also open the NAS shared-folder permissions and grant read/write to the account used to mount it. A Docker rw setting cannot override a read-only host mount or NAS account.
BaiduSetup.storageFixOther: If the message reports permissions or a missing directory
BaiduSetup.storageFixPermissions: For permission errors, grant the Ella service user write and directory traversal access through the folder’s permissions or ACL. The official container uses UID 1001. Changing permissions alone cannot fix a read-only mount.
BaiduSetup.storageFixMissing: For a missing directory, reconnect or mount the storage first. Check the host folder in Compose, or VIDEO_ROOT for a direct deployment. Do not create an empty folder in place of a disconnected media mount.
BaiduSetup.storageFixRecheck: Return here and select “Check again”. Continue when Video library access shows Ready.
